Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.KeyboardSettings struct with custom detection, minimum press count, minimum press interval, and minimum used duration values. Other values are set to their defaults.

public KeyboardSettings(bool detection, int minPressCount = 2, float minPressInterval = 1, float minUsedDuration = 0.5, float selectionCooldownDuration = 2, HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton>? exceptionButtons = null)

Parameters

detection bool

Indicates whether keyboard detection is enabled.

minPressCount int

The minimum number of keyboard button presses required within the specified interval.

minPressInterval float

The time interval (in seconds) from the first keyboard button press within which minPressCount must be reached.

minUsedDuration float

The minimum duration (in seconds) of consecutive keyboard use required to consider the keyboard device as "used".

selectionCooldownDuration float

Specifies the cooldown duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Default is 2 seconds.

exceptionButtons HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton>

The set of keyboard buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed. Optional.

Fields

Default

Gets the default InputSettings.KeyboardSettings instance with preset values.

public static readonly InputSettings.KeyboardSettings Default

Field Value

InputSettings.KeyboardSettings

Detection

Indicates whether the input device can be changed to keyboard.

public bool Detection

Field Value

bool

Remarks

Default is true Does not affect WasUsedRaw() values. It does affect the automatic system in InputSystem to switch between devices.

ExceptionButtons

The set of gamepad buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed.

public readonly HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton> ExceptionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton>

MinPressCount

The minimum number of keyboard button presses required, within the specified interval, to consider the keyboard device as "used".

public int MinPressCount

Field Value

int

Remarks

Default is 2 presses within 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinPressInterval

The time interval (in seconds) from the first keyboard button press within which MinPressCount must be reached for the keyboard device to be considered "used".

public float MinPressInterval

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinUsedDuration

The minimum duration (in seconds) of consecutive keyboard use (movement or holding at least one button down) required to consider the keyboard device as "used".

public float MinUsedDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 0.5f seconds. Does work in combination with MinPressCount / MinPressInterval but has a higher priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

SelectionButtons

The set of gamepad buttons that can be used to select this device. When set and not empty, all other means of selection are disabled.

public readonly HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton> SelectionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeKeyboardButton>

SelectionCooldownDuration

Specifies the duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Used to prevent rapid switching between input devices.

public float SelectionCooldownDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 2 seconds. Zero and negative values disable the cooldown.

Properties

ExceptionButtonsEnabled

Gets a value indicating whether exception buttons are enabled for this device. Returns true if ExceptionButtons is not null and contains at least one button. These buttons will never select this device, even if pressed.

public bool ExceptionButtonsEnabled { get; }

Property Value

bool

PressCountEnabled

Gets a value indicating whether press count detection is enabled for the keyboard. Detection is enabled when MinPressCount is greater than 1 and MinPressInterval is greater than 0.

public bool PressCountEnabled { get; }

Property Value

bool

SelectionButtonsEnabled

Gets a value indicating whether selection buttons are enabled for this device. Returns true if SelectionButtons is not null and contains at least one button. When enabled, the device can only be selected with the specified special buttons.

public bool SelectionButtonsEnabled { get; }

Property Value

bool

UsedDurationEnabled

Indicates whether used duration detection is enabled (requires MinUsedDuration to be greater than zero).

public bool UsedDurationEnabled { get; }

bool
